entries.7ca2615db37c9e6e: A self-improvement service for individuals that lets users enjoy popular business books, classics and bestsellers in summaries of about 10 minutes per 1 book. It uses a monthly subscription model, and more than 9 tenths of the summaries can also be listened to as audio. It also operates the online reading community "flier book labo," the short-term course "flier book camp" and the "flier Official Channel."
